value.rationale: The exact all-profile canonical cut/cycle l1 and l-infinity norms are natural Banach complementability and edge-current amplification invariants. The theorem does more than evaluate a textbook identity: it resolves all distinct edge-part orbits in arbitrary asymmetric complete multipartite graphs and proves an infinite, sharp qualitative divergence of cut versus cycle maximizing orbits. It explicitly excludes minimization among nonorthogonal projections.
